not_in_the_record.reason: files downloaded from their own sources or supplied by the organisers; they are redistributed only after the licence of each has been read, and until then they are fetched by name and checksum from their source

predictions of TabPFN: the weights that the pinned package downloads are under non-commercial licences of Prior Labs that limit their outputs to non-commercial use, and the record is CC BY 4.0, which allows commercial use; they are rebuilt by the job that made them after the licence has been accepted
embeddings of the ChemBERTa checkpoint seyonec/ChemBERTa-zinc-base-v1, whose card states no licence
a snapshot of the structure results from before the retry of the affinity head: its error messages carry the paths of the machine that ran it, and the results after the retry are in the record

the log of the last run of the pre-submission gate, which reads files that exist only on the machine that ran it and is rewritten by every run; the checks of the gate that matter for the record are in the audit report
